changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.1 test build: adds Android phone/tablet Integrated Player compatibility for Standard TV by routing the opened raw MPEG-TS source through Jellyfin's HLS-compatible path, plus vertically stacked channel Actions with a red, confirmed Delete button. No other playback or scheduling behavior is intentionally changed.
